# Third-party art (originals)

Downloaded packs can be kept here locally; they are **not committed** (large, and can be downloaded again).
Anything the game actually uses gets exported to `Art/...` and imported into `Content/CountriesIRL/...`,
and is listed below with its source and license.

| Pack | Source | License | Status |
|---|---|---|---|
| Modular Character Outfits - Fantasy [Standard] | https://quaternius.com | CC0 1.0 | Tried for the body prototype (2026-09-27), removed: the game stays pure countryballs |
| Ultimate Animated Animal Pack (July 2021) | https://quaternius.com/packs/ultimateanimatedanimals.html | CC0 1.0 | **Used:** animals in `Content/CountriesIRL/Animals` (FBX imported with `Tools/Unreal/import_fbx_skeletal.py` at real-life scale; alpaca not used) |
